about_the_game:
What is WoColor8?

WoColor8 is a software tool that brings “4096+ color flat 3D printing” to ordinary FDM printers. Using 8 base filaments and a multi-layer material stacking technique, it turns your images into fully printable, full-color flat 3D models.

Whether you’re a creator, designer, or simply want to make a personalized piece, WoColor8 helps you turn any image into a tangible, colorful object.

WoColor8 supports automatic color matching.

Of course, this is based on the number of filament types actually available. The more filament colors you have, the closer the result can match your expected colors.

Turn any image into a 3D printable color model — with one click

Load any image and instantly get:

  • An automatically generated flat 3D color model

  • Real-time preview (very close to the final printed result)

  • Adjustable size, material scheme, and color configuration

  • One-click export to a ready-to-print file

No modeling experience required — the software handles all the complex calculations and layering for you.

Why is WoColor8 different?

● 4096+ Colors (with 8 base materials)

Colors are produced through material stacking rather than ink or dye. This results in more stable, more affordable, and more controllable color output.

● Compatible with ordinary FDM 3D printers

No hardware modification needed. If you have a multi-material system (such as AMS), you can print using 2 / 4 / 6 / 8-color modes.

● Real-time preview that closely matches the real print

Especially when using co-developed, stack-optimized filaments, the on-screen preview is almost identical to the actual object.

A new way for 2D images to “become physical.”

Core Features

  • Image → Flat full-color 3D model

  • Preset color palettes / Custom colors

  • Flexible size and thickness adjustments

  • One-click generation of print-ready files

WoColor8 turns color printing from “high-skill and complex” into “press once and done.”

Create colors you can hold in your hand

With WoColor8, your creations no longer stay on the screen — they become real, giftable, displayable, collectible objects.

Whether it’s a cherished photo, game character, hand-drawn illustration, logo, or icon, everything can become a clear, durable, full-color flat 3D print.

Simple · Intelligent · Efficient Bring your images to life.
